Hi Emma — great news, congrats to your team. High-level answers below and I attached a quick MAP draft that maps the staggered activation to keys and capacity.

- Provisioning cadence: we recommend weekly batches of 1–2 project keys during the first month (proof-of-concept + one pilot), then bi-weekly activations afterward. This minimizes churn and lets us tune batching and KV cache per project.
- Billing during ramp: usage-based billing continues per API key; we can put the new keys under a single billing seat and apply a temporary ramp rate adjustment for the first 60 days to smooth over punchy spikes.
- Terms/SLA: if you want committed capacity for steady latency targets we should formalize an addendum — short version: a 3–6 month ramp with a revised committed token commit changes pricing tiers and adds an SLA appendix.

I've attached: NovusCare-MAP-v2.pdf and a high-level forecast. If you like this, I'll draft a short SLA amendment and run it with our legal/commercial.

Next steps: can you confirm the order of teams (which team goes first) and target pilot start week?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
